camel_example: aliyun vod GetEditingProjectMaterials --region cn-hangzhou --MaterialType video --Type video --ProjectId 19823610110933740000
description_en: Retrieves the list of materials to be edited in an online editing project
description_zh: 调用本接口获取云剪辑工程的待剪辑素材列表
kebab_example: aliyun vod get-editing-project-materials --project-id 19823610110933740000 --type video --material-type video --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetEditingProjectMaterials

parameters.help_en:
The online editing project ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
Log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com), and choose Production Center > Video Editing to view the ID.
Obtain the value of the ProjectId response parameter when you create a project by calling the CreateEditingProject operation
parameters.help_zh:
云剪辑工程ID。可通过以下方式获取：
登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择制作中心 > 视频剪辑，查看ID。
通过创建云剪辑工程接口创建工程时，为返回参数ProjectId的值
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The material type. Valid values:

video: video
audio: audio-only
parameters.help_zh:
素材类型。取值：

video：视频
audio：纯音频
